data.action: 天窗日光下俯身扶台回眸
data.description: 白日阳光透过剧场巨大天窗倾泻在舞台中央，星野爱身着紫色兔女郎紧身衣与半透白丝，俯身手扶舞台边缘回眸眨眼，兔子尾巴微颤，细腰挺胸在明媚天光下充满灵动魅力。
data.lighting: 天窗日光从舞台侧上方落下，在紫色衣料和白袜上留下柔和明暗
data.promptProse: Ai, in a purple bunny costume with a pink heart clasp and sheer white stockings, braces both hands on the stage edge and winks back. Daylight from the theater skylight falls from the upper side, leaving soft light and shade across the purple fabric, white stockings and stage floor.
data.title: 星野爱 · 剧场阳光舞台兔女郎
data.animaCaption: Both hands brace on the stage edge as she winks back.
